nextTask: V3-04 repair — address the 4 must-fix findings on the preserved WIP baseline. (1) DOUBLE-APPLY SETTLEMENT: handleCompenserConfirm applies the settlement delta directly to snapshotRef then emits 'settlement'; the screen's own handler re-reads and applies the delta again via stale closure. Fix: either skip the emit after direct application, or make handleDataChange idempotent by tracking which settlement ids have been processed (e.g. a settlementsRef synced synchronously when the delta is applied). Add a test asserting both contribution and money balances equal full ledger replay after repos.settlements.create, and that the snapshot is not corrupted (contribution a=15/b=-15, not a=0/b=0). (2) CUSTOM-SPLIT EXPENSE DELTA: handleDataChange always applies equal-split math (share=floor(amountMinor/count), remainder to first) regardless of splitMode. Fix: reuse allocateExpense(entry) or replicate its splitMode-aware logic so the delta matches full replay for both equal and custom splits. Add a test asserting delta == full replay for a custom-split expense. (3) EDIT/DELETE SIGNAL: submitEdit and handleDelete in add.tsx emit no data-change signal. Fix: emit the appropriate signal after successful edit and delete (emitDataChange('contribution'|'expense', currentHouseholdId)). Make the Balances delta handler process removals (detect removed ids, apply remove deltas) and modifications (remove old effect, apply new). Add a test asserting snapshot == full replay after a delete and after an edit. (4) SCREEN-LEVEL TEST: add a test that renders the Balances screen against fake repositories, adds/edits/deletes an entry via the fake repo, emits the data-change signal, and asserts the view updates via delta with bounded repository call counts (no full re-read). Remove or substantiate the header claim. Preserve all V3-01/V3-02/V3-03 acceptance.
